gloss: queen consort; queen (wife of a king)

definitions.gloss: queen consort; queen (wife of a king)
definitions.explanation: The wife of a king. Distinct from a queen regnant (女王, a queen who rules in her own right). Used for both historical and contemporary royal contexts.

examples.japanese: {王妃|おうひ}は{国民|こくみん}に{愛|あい}された。
examples.english: The queen was loved by the people.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}き{王妃|おうひ}は{美|うつく}しさで{知|し}られていた。
examples.english: The young queen was known for her beauty.

examples.japanese: マリー・アントワネットはフランス{最後|さいご}の{王妃|おうひ}として{歴史|れきし}に{名|な}を{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: Marie Antoinette left her mark on history as the last queen of France.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers specifically to the wife of a king, not to a ruling queen. For a female monarch who rules in her own right, use {女王|じょおう}.

RELATED WORDS:
- {女王|じょおう}: queen regnant (a queen who rules)
- {王|おう}: king
- {皇后|こうごう}: empress (wife of an emperor, used for the Japanese imperial family)
- {妃|きさき}/{妃|ひ}: consort, princess (more general term)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {王妃|おうひ}の{座|ざ}: the throne/position of queen
- {王妃|おうひ}{殿下|でんか}: Her Majesty the Queen
- {王妃|おうひ}を{迎|むか}える: to welcome a queen consort
